why.title: Nobody shops for this on a calm day.
paragraphs: "My mom almost sent them money." "I can't afford a lawyer for every little thing." "We really need to do a will." If you've said one of these, you know the worry: something goes wrong and you're not sure who you'd call.

Most people set this up after a scam call or a contract they didn't understand. Justin helps families get it in place before that, so when a strange letter or a legal question shows up, you already know where to take it.

story.title: Why families talk to Justin
paragraphs: Justin Nguyen is a father of three and an entrepreneur. His background spans engineering and dentistry, and he spent over 20 years in technology, with roles at Apple, Microsoft and Intel.

He is a licensed tax preparer, and his work in legal and financial protection includes PPLSI (LegalShield) and 101 Financial. He is also Regional Director of Oregon and Director of Communications at NowTRANSFORMED.
He is fluent in Vietnamese and believes in families helping families. His motto: "Success is We NOT Me."

It's 15 minutes with the NowTRANSFORMED team. They ask what you'd like help with, answer your questions and look at whether a membership fits your family. You can pick any time in the next three weeks, and a lunch break works.

faqs.q: My bank already gives me identity protection.
faqs.a: Good, you're ahead of most people. Bring what you have to the call and ask. If it already covers you, keep it.

faqs.q: Can my spouse or my parents join?
faqs.a: Yes. Couples often decide this together, so bring your husband or wife and hear it once. If your parents are more comfortable in Vietnamese, Justin can go over it with them before the call.

faqs.q: How do I know this is legitimate?
faqs.a: Smart to check. LegalShield and IDShield come from PPLSI, and you can look them up yourself. And never send anyone your Social Security number or account numbers by text or email, Justin included.

faqs.q: Is this one of those pyramid things?
faqs.a: LegalShield has a separate business side, where people sign up as independent associates. This page and this call are only about protection for your family.
